body: Update: before it stood down, the advisor's fixer had opened aida-host PR #7 (claude/fix-29b @ 49b547ea31, BUG-84) with ONLY the SIGINT/SIGQUIT restore plus SigIgn tests. A STRICT review is running now, and it is the fastest path to removing the live hazard. Please drop your own sig_restore change and rebase your WIP branch on PR #7 once it merges. Notes from that fixer for your remaining work: (a) do NOT put the slot child in its own process group: terminal Ctrl-C would stop reaching cargo, and an interactive cargo run would get SIGTTIN; (b) write ticket start-time content via a temp file + mv, so a reader never sees an empty live ticket as stale; (c) cargo-log parses acq.<pid> with 't_acq, slot = ...split()', so adding a field breaks it; use split()[:2] first; (d) the sccache daemon started under queue.lock inherits that fd and can hold the lock forever if the wrapper is SIGKILLed; close fd 9 (or whichever) before starting sccache. Also: merging #7 needs the primary checkout clean. Please confirm your WIP is moved off /home/joe/ai/aida-host.
subject: Build on aida-host PR #7 (SIGINT fix, under review); don't redo it
